Bulletin Desc: The Town of Montague will receive Responses from qualified individuals, partnerships, or firms for Selective demolition of up to 7 multistory mill buildings between an active canal and a river, constructing new 20' high concrete retaining walls, multi-story CMU walls, and exterior steel stair tower, processing brick & concrete as backfill, and other site improvements at the former Strathmore Mill site, 20 Canal Road, Turners Falls, MA. RFQ documents are available at www.biddocs.com.
